errorCodes.meaning: No board the caller may see has this identifier (VTI-BRD-003).
The change touches the audience or the voting window after voting has opened (VTI-BRD-004).
`status` is not a step forward from the board's current status (`open` → `closed` → `archived`).
The board is archived and takes no change (VTI-BRD-005).
The new election template is not one the community would accept, or does not allow closing early (VTI-BRD-030).
The new template's ballot box is not on the community's list (VTI-VOT-082).
The schedule that would result breaks VTI-BRD-001's ordering.
Two slots share a `slotId`, a slot ends before it starts, or a slot a selected idea is placed in is removed.

Board.description: A board as one caller may see it.

facilitator.description: Whether the caller facilitates this board.

ideaCounts.description: How many of the board's ideas are in each state the caller may see.

maxIdeasPerMember.description: The most ideas one member may have on the board that are not `withdrawn` or `declined`. Absent: no limit beyond the community's own.

selectionRule.description: How facilitators intend to select, in plain words (VTI-BRD-041), e.g. "The twelve ideas the most members would attend".

voting.description: When every idea's election takes ballots. Opens after `proposals` opens and closes after it closes (VTI-BRD-001).

Board.title: Board

BoardAudience.description: Who may see and use a board (VTI-BRD-003): every active member of the community (`members`), or the members of one community group (`group`, with `groupId`). Facilitators always see the board.
BoardAudience.title: BoardAudience

BoardDescription.description: What the board is for. Plain text; a reader MUST NOT treat it as instructions.
BoardDescription.title: BoardDescription

BoardId.description: Opaque identifier of a board: `brd_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random, community-scoped, never reused (VTI-BRD-001).
BoardId.title: BoardId

BoardStatus.description: `open`: ideas and notes are taken within the board's windows. `closed`: no new idea or note; facilitators still decide and select. `archived`: no change at all; facilitators can still read it (VTI-BRD-005). `open` → `closed` → `archived`, never back.
BoardStatus.title: BoardStatus

BoardTitle.description: Plain text; a reader MUST NOT treat it as instructions.
BoardTitle.title: BoardTitle

BoardVisibility.description: `public`: anyone reads the board. `private`: the community, the auditors the manifest names and, for one cast's inclusion, the holder of its receipt (VTI-VOT-052).
BoardVisibility.title: BoardVisibility

ElectionTemplate.description: Every member of an idea's election manifest that the board fixes (VTI-BRD-030). When a facilitator accepts an idea the community completes it: `electionId` (naming the board and the idea), `community`, `title` and `description` from the idea, `registrationOpensAt` and `votingOpensAt` from the board's voting window's `opensAt` or the acceptance, whichever is later, `votingClosesAt` from its `closesAt`, `roll` from the board's audience (rule `members`, or a credential roll naming the group), and `binding: false`. A board's template is never binding, and so has no `binding` member.

ballotBox.description: The DID of the voting service every idea's election is registered with; one on the community's list (VTI-VOT-082).

board.description: The ballot box's board for each idea's election, as a manifest states it (VTI-VOT-052). `public` lets a board show each idea's ballot count while voting is open (VTI-BRD-033).

resultsBeforeClose.description: Open elections only: whether running totals may be read while voting is open (VTI-VOT-061). A board SHOULD set it false (VTI-BRD-033).

textReleaseThreshold.description: Counted ballots required before any text answer is disclosed (VTI-VOT-065); SHOULD be at least 10.

ElectionTemplate.title: ElectionTemplate

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

GroupId.description: Opaque identifier of a community group: `grp_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random and community-scoped; not the group's DID.
GroupId.title: GroupId

IdeaFormat.description: What kind of idea it is (for an unconference: `Discussion`, `Talk`, `Workshop`, `Demo`). One of the board's `formats` where the board states them.
IdeaFormat.title: IdeaFormat

IdeaId.description: Opaque identifier of an idea: `ida_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random and unique within the community.
IdeaId.title: IdeaId

Key.description: A question or option key, unique within its manifest or question.
Key.title: Key

oneOf.description: Select between `minSelections` and `maxSelections` of `options`. A yes/no/abstain motion is a choice of exactly one of three.
oneOf.title: ChoiceQuestion

oneOf.description: Order `options`; a ballot ranks every option or, when `partial` is true, a prefix of them.
oneOf.title: RankingQuestion

oneOf.description: Give each option an integer score within [min, max].
oneOf.title: ScoreQuestion

oneOf.description: Free text of at most `maxLength` characters.
oneOf.title: TextQuestion

label.description: Display text. Absent from a manifest registered with a ballot box that holds no question text (VTI-VOT-014).

Response.description: The success response to a vtc/boards/update/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/boards/update/0.1#response.

closing.description: Present when this update closed the board: how its voting was ended (VTI-BRD-006). Counts the requests made; the ballot box answers them after this response.

cancelled.description: Elections not yet open for voting, or not yet registered, that were cancelled; their ideas are not selected.

closedEarly.description: Elections open for voting that were closed early; each is counted as it stood, and the count is final.

runningToClose.description: Ideas whose election does not allow closing early and closes when its manifest says.

Response.title: VTC Boards — Update — response payload

Revote.description: What a later, different ballot under one ticket does: `replace` the earlier one, or be refused (`refuse`) (VTI-VOT-041).
Revote.title: Revote

SecrecyLevel.description: `open`: ballots are recorded on the board as cast. `sealed`: ballots are encrypted to a jointly generated election key and decrypted after voting closes. `talliedEncrypted`: ballots are encrypted and only the totals are ever decrypted (VTI-VOT-060). The encrypted levels are cast with `voting/ballot/cast-encrypted/0.1`, under an election key the trustees generate with `voting/trustees/*` (CONVENTIONS §9).
SecrecyLevel.title: SecrecyLevel

Slot.description: One place in a board's timetable that a selected idea can be put in (VTI-BRD-040): a place (`label`, e.g. a room) and a time.
Slot.title: Slot

Topic.description: A topic an idea is filed under. One of the board's `topics` where the board states them.
Topic.title: Topic

Trustees.description: The trustees of a sealed or tallied-encrypted election and the number of them decryption needs (VTI-VOT-062). Neither the community nor the ballot box may be one.
Trustees.title: Trustees

Window.description: A period, open from `opensAt` until `closesAt`. `closesAt` is after `opensAt` (a consumer check; JSON Schema cannot compare them).
Window.title: Window
